criteria.name: json_schema_and_rounding
criteria.description: Returns the six requested fields with numeric values rounded to 4 decimals and the final label as a string.
criteria.partial_credit: 1 to 2 points for minor rounding or field-name errors.

criteria.name: radar_score_calculation
criteria.description: Applies the weighted radar formula with the maximum VV term clamped to 1.0 and reports 0.6395.
criteria.partial_credit: Up to 3 points for correct components with one arithmetic or clamp error.

criteria.name: context_score_calculations
criteria.description: Computes annual 0.2172, burn-like 0.2017, rainfall 0.1241, and context maximum 0.2172.
criteria.partial_credit: 1 point for each correct score or maximum.

criteria.name: margin_and_threshold_tests
criteria.description: Computes pathway margin 0.4223 and verifies the radar, context, margin, and rainfall thresholds.
criteria.partial_credit: Up to 3 points for correct margin with incomplete threshold checks.

criteria.name: thermal_gate
criteria.description: Computes thermal_gate_c = 0.6093 C and uses the positive value in the final rule result.
criteria.partial_credit: 1 to 2 points for correct temperature anchor with incomplete subtraction or threshold use.

criteria.name: compact_consequence_label
criteria.description: Returns passes_localized_glof_pathway_signal and keeps any final sentence tied to the calculations without a broad narrative.
criteria.partial_credit: 1 point for a close pass label with weaker calculation linkage.
